annotations.title: Can AI assistants read this website?

description: Checks whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, Google (Gemini) and Mistral Le Chat can read a website: robots.txt rules for each AI crawler (certain), the home page requested as each crawler versus a normal browser (probable — real crawlers come from other IPs), and page-level blockers (noindex, nosnippet, JavaScript-only pages). Nothing is stored. Requires this connector's access pass (€9.90 for 24 hours, or €29 per month). Docs: https://seorecords.com/assistants

access_key.description: Access key (pass_…) of this connector, shown after buying its 24-hour pass or monthly subscription. Required.
